recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future role terminology policy change should be a new Security work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-32520 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5. It asked that agent.role avoid broad/extensible terminology expectations and use an example binding to a curated structural-role value set.
initial_application: Commit f577d68ceb applied FHIR-32520 together with FHIR-32453, updated AuditEvent/Provenance agent.role wording, kept example bindings, and replaced the old mixed role-code value set with sample structural role content. Later maintenance renamed and cleaned the artifacts to security-role-type-example and security-structural-roles-example.
additional_context: AuditEvent and Provenance are active current-build resources, and the structural role code system is active in source/fhir.ini. Current AuditEvent.agent.role and Provenance.agent.role both bind at example strength to security-role-type-example, which includes only the example structural-role code system. Later FHIR-53882 changed AuditEvent wording but did not reopen the binding/value-set cleanup.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because the current role binding and value-set source match the FHIR-32520 outcome.
